いこう、
リマちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: Yes! {0}-kun! Let's reach our "happily ever after" with our own hands!

text_block_list.text:
With the power of his love, I'll make you all fluffy!
LOVEY-DOVEY FLUFFY STRIKE!!!

あなたをモフモフにしちゃうわ！
らぶらぶもふもふストライク！
